premise: At sunset Parasaurolophus wants to call her friends from far across the valley; her little hum is far too soft, so she takes a deep breath and blows it through her long hollow crest — HONK — and they come to sleep beside her.
inspiration: The shepherd's horn of folk tales (calling the flock home at dusk), with a horn she was born with.
learning: Parasaurolophus's long crest was hollow inside; blowing air through it made a deep, booming call.

en-US.title: The Bedtime Honk
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8} {sfx:evening} [softly] The sun was going down over the valley, gold and pink. {parasaurolophus:enter} Parasaurolophus looked out across the valley. Bedtime! But her friends were still far away: {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus, running about, and {ankylosaurus:enter} Ankylosaurus, sniffing the ground, slow as ever. {parasaurolophus:live talk} "Hmm, hmm," she hummed. "Time for bed!" Nobody heard. {parasaurolophus:face sad} It was much too soft. Then she had an idea. {parasaurolophus:face happy} Her long crest was hollow inside, just like a horn. So she took a big, deep breath… {parasaurolophus:live honk hold} {sfx:honk} and blew it all through her crest. HOOOONK! Far away, {gallimimus:face surprised} {gallimimus:live look-around} Gallimimus stopped and looked. [excited] "That's our call!" {gallimimus:go to parasaurolophus} And off she ran. {ankylosaurus:face happy} {ankylosaurus:go to parasaurolophus} Ankylosaurus came plodding after, step… by… step. {parasaurolophus:live honk resume} {canvas:night 0.7} Up came the moon. {ankylosaurus:live sleep hold} Ankylosaurus lay down and was asleep before he'd even finished his yawn. {gallimimus:face sleeping} [whispers] And Parasaurolophus gave one last honk, the tiniest one of all. {parasaurolophus:pulse 0.3} Honk. Goodnight.

es-ES.title: El toque de buenas noches
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8} {sfx:evening} [softly] El sol se ponía sobre el valle, dorado y rosa. {parasaurolophus:enter} Parasaurolophus miró a lo lejos. ¡Hora de dormir! Pero sus amigos andaban todavía muy lejos: {gallimimus:enter} Gallimimus, corriendo de acá para allá, y {ankylosaurus:enter} Anquilosaurio, olisqueando el suelo, despacito como siempre. {parasaurolophus:live talk} —Mmm, mmm —canturreó—. ¡A la cama! Nadie la oyó. {parasaurolophus:face sad} Era un sonido demasiado flojito. Entonces se le ocurrió una idea. {parasaurolophus:face happy} Su larga cresta estaba hueca por dentro, igual que una trompeta. Así que cogió aire, muchísimo aire… {parasaurolophus:live honk hold} {sfx:honk} y lo sopló todo por la cresta. ¡TUUUUUU! A lo lejos, {gallimimus:face surprised} {gallimimus:live look-around} Gallimimus se paró a mirar. [excited] —¡Nos están llamando! {gallimimus:go to parasaurolophus} Y allá que fue, corriendo. {ankylosaurus:face happy} {ankylosaurus:go to parasaurolophus} Anquilosaurio fue detrás, paso… a… paso. {parasaurolophus:live honk resume} {canvas:night 0.7} Salió la luna. {ankylosaurus:live sleep hold} Anquilosaurio se tumbó y se durmió antes de terminar el bostezo. {gallimimus:face sleeping} [whispers] Y Parasaurolophus dio un último toque, el más chiquitito de todos. {parasaurolophus:pulse 0.3} Tu. Buenas noches.

evening.prompt: a calm warm evening in a quiet valley, soft distant insects and a gentle breeze, realistic field recording

honk.prompt: a deep, warm, booming call blown through a long hollow horn, like a big gentle animal calling across a valley at dusk, realistic, no voice
